contentPattern.structure: grid of topic teaser cards, each an image + uppercase category label + linked heading; supports an occasional blockquote card

suitableFor: editorial topic teaser grids (image + category + linked heading)
content hubs mixing photo cards with an occasional quote card
notSuitableFor: statistic / KPI strips with icons and figures (use cards-stats)
filterable article lists with load-more (use cards-articles)
